description: Audits a kensaiapp pipeline skill through an artifact it produced. Spawns the blind auditor fan-out (one kensaiapp-auditor per lens, none of them given the skill) over the artifact and its inputs, then the non-blind synthesis passes (version comparison, surfaced-set comparison) over both versions of the outputs, and gathers every finding into an audit.md beside the artifact. The caller supplies the evidence, the surfacing fact, and any prior round; this skill runs the auditors and collects what they find. Use to run the audit over a settled, snapshotted artifact — "audit this evidence", "fan out the auditors", "audit the <skill> output". Emits findings only. It does not produce the evidence it reads and does not act on the findings it emits.
